name: Tonoris, Lone Mercenary's On Enter: gain taunt until next turn
notes: Tonoris, Lone Mercenary is level 1, one level above the default level-0 starting champion (Spirit of Fire), so no lineage/element patch is needed -- 0+1 is already a legal level-up. Champion-swap materialization is only offered through the material-phase MZMAYCHOOSE at the start of a turn, so both players end their first turn (P1 -> P2) to reach that prompt on P1's next turn; its 1-memory cost is paid from a filler card seeded directly into myMemory. Choosing it completes the swap and its On Enter ability (GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["zb14m4c8lj:0"]) calls AddTurnEffect on the champion itself, confirmed by the TurnEffects array carrying TAUNT_NEXT_TURN (alongside the standard ENTERED_THIS_TURN marker).

rulesClauses: On Enter: Tonoris gains taunt until the beginning of your next turn.
